trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- The affected service was identified as **payments-worker** (v3.4.0, healthy=false, ~18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). My first attempt to roll back payments-api was rejected by the human approver, who pointed out the correct service.
- The most recent healthy release in production was **v3.3.0**, so I rolled payments-worker back to v3.3.0 in all production regions. The change was approved and rolled out successfully.
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("payments-worker unhealthy since morning v3.4.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer to verify recovery and root-cause the v3.4.0 regression.
